Homes & spaces.

TWO FICTIONAL PROJECT BRIEFS
01 / RESIDENTIAL

Aangan House

Residential concept study

A home concept organised around an aangan (courtyard), a shaded entrance, and shared family spaces.

Explore the project story

Spatial intention

A sequence from a sheltered entry to a shared living area. The courtyard creates a pause between private rooms.

Material direction

Pale mineral surfaces, timber screens, and a restrained palette. This is a visual concept, not a construction specification.

02 / RETREAT

Verandah Retreat

Retreat concept study

A retreat concept with a broad verandah connecting the shared living room to the outdoors.

Explore the retreat story

Spatial intention

One shared room on an open platform, with a generous roof that makes the threshold feel like part of the interior.

Material direction

Timber structure and warm stone tones. No structural, regulatory or environmental performance claims are made.

THE STUDIO PHILOSOPHY / CONCEPT

Begin with a place.
Design for a life.

01 / Observe

Understand light, surroundings, and the habits a space needs to support.

02 / Shape

Connect rooms through clear circulation, thresholds, and useful shared space.

03 / Refine

Bring proportion and material together around the original intention.
